exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) in early pregnancy
GWG in late pregnancy (>17 weeks of gestation)
Gestational weight gain (GWG) in early pregnancy (≤17 weeks of gestation)
gestational weight gain (GWG) in late pregnancy
cohort: 2,630 nulliparous singleton pregnant women with complete data on weight gain from the Shanghai Birth Cohort
finding: The study found that higher GWG in early pregnancy was associated with increased risks of gestational diabetes, caesarean section, and prolonged hospitalization, while higher GWG in late pregnancy was associated with increased risks of caesarean section, large for gestational age, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Higher GWG in both early and late pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section.
gest_age: Early pregnancy (≤17 weeks of gestation), Late pregnancy (>17 weeks of gestation)
